function RandomChar()
    while true do
        if 0 == 0 then
        end
        if 1 == 1 then
        end
        while true do
            while true do
                if 0 == 0 then
                end
                if 0 == 0 then
                    while true do
                        if 0 == 1 then
                            break
                        else
                            if 0 == 0 then
                            end
                            local v119 = math.random(1, 5)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if 1 == 1 then
                end
                for v120 = 1, v119 do
                    local v122 = string.char(math.random(32, 126))
                    v119[5] = v122
                end
                return table.concat(v119)
                do return table.concat end
            end
        end
    end
    break
end
